scope: evaluation code only; the protocol and its four predictions are unchanged
what_was_wrong: The P2/P3/P4 verdicts were computed against the channel name 'collision', which erratum 1 renamed to 'adversarial'. The filter matched nothing, so P3 was reported False and P4 True on an empty set.
how_it_was_caught: The printed table showed a likelihood-ratio rule at balanced accuracy 0.943 with worst-case unsafe-to-Certify 0.747 on the adversarial channel, which is P3 by definition, while the verdict line said P3 was False.
correction: The filter now names the adversarial channel. P3 is True and P4 is False.
note: Both errata were caught because the predictions were written down before the run. Neither changes a measured number.
